player.key.panic: {key} or Ctrl+Space: hide the screen right now. Press it again (or Enter) to come back. That scene is saved and skipped next time.
player.key.panicRight: Right arrow while hidden: jump ahead 10 seconds
player.markAdded: Scene marked {start} - {end}. It is waiting for your review.
player.panicSaved: Scene hidden and saved. It will be skipped from now on.
player.crashedRelaunch: The player closed unexpectedly. Opening it again where you left off.
player.crashedFinal: The player closed again. Your marks are safe. Try once more, or restart the computer if it keeps happening.
player.kidRefused: This movie is not ready for kid mode. Scan and review it first, then try again.
player.skipfileError: The protection list for this movie could not be read. It played without protection. Rescan the movie to fix it.
player.startFailed: The movie could not be opened. Check that the file is still there and try again.
player.notFound: The player is missing. Reinstall bonis oculis to fix it.
